cc:Work.dc:title: Conditional and integrated predictions
cc:Work.dc:description: Left: fixed, empirical-Bayes and integrated latent intervals; pale band adds observation noise. Right: twelve whole-curve draws using shared hyperparameters, with threshold .8.
